x: Trevor Tolson, who is hurdling extremely well these days, turned out to be a surprise winner of the 120 yds hurdles title in a time of 15.7secs.
The "Hurdlers Strike" obviously favoured Trevor Tolson and Alan Spicer (Hildreth and Matthews withdrew claiming that the fierce 30 mph wind was to great to run into).

Another star performer was Trevor Tolson who won the 110 metres hurdles in a new Club record of 15.3secs. Trevor's morning had been spent travelling down from Liverpool, but he certainly proved his journey was worthwhile.

Trevor Tolson, after travelling all the way from Hull, took 4th place in the final of the 120 yards hurdles recording 16.0 seconds. Peter Pepe went one better in the final of the 440 yards hurdles, and but for "fluffing" the last hurdle would have been second; despite this he still recorded 59.2 seconds.
He won by a good 15 yards in 49.0 seconds. Trevor Tolson was a clear winner in the high hurdles, recording 16.0 seconds against the wind.

Trevor Tolson ran in the 100 yards, Dave Carter the 220, Alan Jackson and John Thresher the 880, and Clive Shippen the steeplechase. Peter Eldridge was one of two athletes to suffer at the hands of a poor starter in the 440 yards final, and although well down at the start still managed to finish 3rd.
Once again Trevor Tolson annexed the 120 yards hurdles title. Despite a troublesome head wind he recorded 16.2 seconds.
